note: Knockout bracket lineage for World Cup 2026: which earlier matches feed each knockout slot, keyed by fifaMatchNo. R32 slots (73-88) are decided by the group tables plus FIFA's third-place allocation, which depends on WHICH eight thirds qualify — so R32 participants are taken from the results feed rather than modeled here. From the round of 16 on, every slot is a pure winner/loser link per the official FIFA match schedule (third-place game takes the semi-final losers). The R16 and QF links have been cross-checked against the observed 2026 pairings.
source: FIFA World Cup 26 official match schedule
